verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no official Glama CLI. Glama offers a browser inspector, a REST API with an OpenAPI spec "for generating a client", and config blocks to paste into MCP clients. The spec and the cURL samples are developer building blocks, not a shipped CLI. The mention of tunneling local servers "using mcp-proxy" does not establish an official Glama command-line tool for users.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
